0.content: Mallko was Vichama's childhood friend and fighting partner, a strong fighter who could knock out several opponents with a single blow. Five years before the Archon Quests the two won the Pilgrimage of the Sacred Flame and were chosen for the Night Warden Wars. After Vichama was injured, Mallko's team went without him and was overwhelmed by Abyssal monsters. Vichama's ritual caused parts of Mallko's self to reassemble in the Night Kingdom, where he helped the rescue party; after the Abyss was beaten, he and Vichama were reunited.

1.content: Citlali's Spiritspeaker Stone links the living world to the Night Kingdom so that an Ancient Name can be fished out with a symbolic net. Vichama set up the ritual in open ground because the Abyss would surge through the link, and used obsidian to store the recovered Names. He found Kachina's Name but not Mallko's, and Chasca destroyed the Stone to stop the Abyssal power from spiralling out of control.
